name: Acadlix LMS – AI Quiz Maker, Online Exam & Course Plugin for WordPress
author: Team AcadLix

sections.description:
Acadlix combines course management, online examinations, AI-assisted content creation, and built-in eCommerce into a single WordPress plugin.

Whether you’re building an online academy, coaching institute, certification platform, employee training portal, or selling digital courses, Acadlix gives you the tools to create engaging learning experiences from one dashboard.

Unlike solutions that require separate plugins for LMS, quizzes, payments, subscriptions, and live classes, Acadlix keeps everything together in a single workflow, reducing setup complexity and ongoing maintenance.

It is suitable for:

• Coaching Institutes
• Schools & Colleges
• Corporate Training
• Certification Programs
• Online Academies
• Tutors & Course Creators
• Competitive Exam Platforms

👉 Acadlix LMS Pro

👉 Live Demo

👉 Documentation

See Acadlix in Action

Create Courses & Quizzes (Full Walkthrough)

AI Quiz Generator

AI Question Validation

Why Choose Acadlix

Building an online learning platform often means installing multiple plugins for courses, quizzes, payments, certificates, and live classes.

Acadlix brings these essential tools together in a single plugin designed specifically for educators and training organizations.

Whether you’re creating a small course website or managing a large examination portal, Acadlix helps simplify administration while providing students with a consistent learning experience.

Everything You Need in One Plugin

✓ Create unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and exams

✓ Sell courses without WooCommerce

✓ Generate quiz questions with AI

✓ Validate existing questions using AI

✓ Conduct timed online examinations

✓ Issue certificates

✓ Run live classes

✓ Manage students and enrollments

✓ Track learning progress

✓ Accept online payments

✓ Drip Content and Announcements

Designed for Real Learning Platforms

Acadlix supports a wide range of educational use cases, including:

• Competitive examinations

• Mock test portals

• Professional certification

• Employee training

• Coaching institutes

• School assessments

• College learning portals

Instead of managing multiple disconnected plugins, you can create, deliver, and sell learning content from a single interface.

What You Can Build with Acadlix

Acadlix is designed for more than just online courses. Whether you’re teaching a single class or running a large learning platform, it provides the flexibility to support different teaching and business models.

Use Acadlix to build:

✓ Online Course Websites

✓ Competitive Exam Portals

✓ Mock Test Platforms

✓ Certification Programs

✓ Employee Training Systems

✓ School & College Learning Portals

✓ Coaching Institute Websites

✓ Paid Test Series

✓ Continuing Education Programs

✓ Skill Assessment Platforms

From structured learning paths to timed online examinations, Acadlix helps you deliver engaging learning experiences while managing students, payments, and progress from one dashboard.

AI-Powered Content Creation

Creating quality learning content takes time. Acadlix includes AI-assisted tools that help reduce repetitive work while keeping you in control of the final content.

Simply connect your own OpenAI API key to start using AI features. There are no platform-imposed credits or monthly usage limits—you only pay your OpenAI usage costs.

AI Features Included in the Free Version

✓ Generate quiz questions from a topic or prompt

✓ Validate existing questions for clarity and accuracy

✓ Create course descriptions

✓ Generate lesson descriptions

✓ Generate quiz descriptions

✓ Improve content writing speed

The AI tools are designed to assist educators, not replace them. Every generated question or description can be reviewed and edited before publishing.

Why Use Your Own OpenAI API Key?

• Full control over AI usage

• No monthly credits managed by Acadlix

• No recurring AI subscription charged by the plugin

• Pay only for your actual OpenAI API consumption

• Continue using your preferred OpenAI account

This approach gives educators complete transparency over AI costs while allowing unlimited usage within their own OpenAI account limits.

Create Courses Without Coding

Organize your learning content using a simple drag-and-drop course builder.

Build structured courses with sections, lessons, quizzes, assignments, downloadable resources, and multimedia content without writing code.

Course Builder Features

✓ Unlimited courses

✓ Unlimited lessons

✓ Unlimited quizzes

✓ Unlimited assignments

✓ Drag-and-drop curriculum builder

✓ Multi-level course structure

✓ Lesson ordering

✓ Course duration

✓ Difficulty levels

✓ Learning outcomes

✓ Featured images

✓ Instructor assignment

✓ Rich text editor

✓ Course Announcements

✓ Logic based Drip Content

Rich Lesson Support

Create engaging lessons using multiple content formats:

• YouTube videos

• Vimeo videos

• Self-hosted videos

• Audio lessons

• PDFs

• Images

• Downloadable resources

• Text-based lessons

Students can move through lessons in an organized learning path while administrators manage everything from a single interface.

Create Professional Online Exams

Acadlix includes a flexible examination system suitable for practice tests, competitive exams, school assessments, certification programs, recruitment tests, and employee evaluations.

Whether you’re creating a short quiz or a full-length mock examination, you can configure assessments to match your teaching or evaluation requirements.

Quiz & Examination Features

✓ Unlimited quizzes

✓ Timed quizzes and examinations

✓ Multiple attempts or attempt limits

✓ Automatic grading

✓ Negative marking

✓ Question randomization

✓ Answer randomization

✓ Question categories

✓ Difficulty levels

✓ Subject-wise organization

✓ Passing score

✓ Instant results

✓ Detailed result reports

✓ Answer explanations

✓ Leaderboards

Supported Question Types

Create assessments using multiple question formats.

• Single Choice (MCQ)

• Multiple Choice

• True / False

• Fill in the Blank

• Sorting

• Matrix Matching

Additional advanced question types (numerical, numerical range, assessment or eassy) are available in Acadlix Pro.

Suitable For

• Competitive examinations

• Entrance tests

• Mock test series

• School assessments

• College examinations

• Professional certification

• Employee evaluations

• Practice quizzes

Whether you’re preparing students for competitive exams or delivering internal company assessments, Acadlix provides the flexibility to support different evaluation methods.

Sell Courses Without WooCommerce

Acadlix includes a built-in payment system that allows you to sell courses and test series without installing a separate eCommerce plugin.

This reduces plugin dependencies and keeps course management, student enrollments, and payments within the same workflow.

Payment Features

✓ Native checkout

✓ One-time payments

✓ Course enrollments

✓ Multi plan Subscriptions (Pro)

✓ Course Bundle (Pro)

✓ Order management

✓ Coupons and discounts

✓ Enrollment management

Supported Payment Gateways

• Stripe

• PayPal

• Razorpay

• PayU

Offline payments are also supported, allowing administrators to accept bank transfers, QR code payments, or other manual payment methods.

Order Management

Track purchases, student enrollments, payment history, and order details from a centralized dashboard.

This makes it easier to manage both educational content and sales without switching between multiple plugins.

Certificates & Learning Progress

Help learners stay motivated by tracking their progress throughout a course.

Administrators can organize structured learning paths while students can monitor completed lessons, quizzes, and overall course progress.

Learning Features

✓ Course completion tracking

✓ Lesson progress

✓ Quiz progress

✓ Student dashboard

✓ Completion certificates

✓ Resume learning

✓ Learning history

Certificates can be issued after learners successfully complete course requirements, making Acadlix suitable for certification programs, training organizations, and continuing education platforms.

A Better Learning Experience

Acadlix is designed to provide a simple learning experience for students while giving administrators the tools they need to manage courses, quizzes, enrollments, and results efficiently.

Instead of navigating multiple plugins, both instructors and learners work from a unified learning platform.

Student Features

✓ Personal learning dashboard

✓ Continue where you left off

✓ Course progress tracking

✓ Quiz history

✓ Result reports

✓ Certificates

✓ Course enrollment history

✓ Downloadable learning resources

✓ Responsive design for desktop, tablet, and mobile

Students can easily access enrolled courses, continue unfinished lessons, review quiz attempts, and monitor their learning progress from one dashboard.

Simplify Course Management

Managing an online learning platform involves more than publishing lessons. Acadlix provides tools that help administrators organize students, courses, and learning content from a central dashboard.

Administration Features

✓ Student management

✓ Instructor management

✓ Bulk student import

✓ Course management

✓ Quiz management

✓ Order management

✓ Coupon management

✓ Certificate management

✓ Import and export tools

✓ Shortcodes

✓ Custom login and registration pages

Whether you’re managing a few students or a growing learning platform, Acadlix helps reduce repetitive administrative work.

Teach Live with Zoom/GMeet/Teams

Combine self-paced learning with scheduled live sessions to create a complete online teaching experience.

Schedule live classes directly from your learning platform and allow enrolled students to join from their course dashboard.

Supported integrations include:

• Zoom

• Google Meet

• Microsoft Teams (Pro)

Live classes can be combined with recorded lessons, quizzes, assignments, and downloadable resources to create blended learning experiences.

This makes Acadlix suitable for coaching institutes, online academies, employee training, and instructor-led certification programs.

Built for Modern WordPress Websites

Acadlix is designed to integrate with modern WordPress websites while remaining easy to customize.

Compatibility

✓ WordPress 6.8+

✓ PHP 8.2+

✓ Elementor

✓ Responsive layouts

✓ Custom shortcodes

✓ Multiple payment gateways

✓ Google reCAPTCHA v3

✓ SEO-friendly URLs

✓ Course-friendly permalink structure

Whether you’re using a classic theme or a page builder, Acadlix can be integrated into your existing website without changing your overall design.

Performance & Reliability

Acadlix is built as an integrated learning platform, reducing the need to combine multiple plugins for courses, quizzes, payments, and student management.

Fewer plugin dependencies often mean:

• Simpler administration

• Easier maintenance

• More consistent user experience

• Centralized course management

Performance depends on your hosting environment, WordPress configuration, installed plugins, and traffic volume. For larger websites, we recommend using quality hosting together with page caching and object caching where appropriate.

Free vs Pro

The free version includes everything needed to launch an online learning platform.

Included in Acadlix Free

✓ Unlimited courses

✓ Unlimited lessons

✓ Unlimited quizzes

✓ AI question generation

✓ AI question validation

✓ AI-generated descriptions

✓ Built-in payments

✓ Certificates

✓ Student dashboard

✓ Elementor integration

✓ Coupons

✓ Course reviews

✓ Course Announcements

✓ Multiple payment gateways

✓ Manual Order creation

✓ Responsive layouts

✓ Import and export tools

When your platform grows, Acadlix Pro adds advanced tools for larger organizations, competitive examinations, and subscription-based learning.

Acadlix Pro Includes

✓ Advanced question types

✓ AI performance feedback

✓ Subscription billing

✓ Live class management

✓ Assignments

✓ Drip Content

✓ Detailed analytics

✓ Competitive exam layouts (IBPS and NTA)

✓ MS Word question importer

✓ Quiz prerequisites

✓ OTP & MFA login

✓ Advanced migration tools

✓ Priority support

Acadlix Pro is designed for organizations that need advanced assessment features, recurring revenue, enterprise administration, and larger-scale learning management.

External Services

Acadlix integrates with third-party services only when certain features are enabled by the site administrator or end users.

Stripe

This plugin integrates with the Stripe payment gateway to securely process online payments.

Stripe is used to handle course purchases, subscriptions, and payment confirmations.

When a user initiates a payment, the following data may be sent to Stripe:

  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Billing details provided by the user
  • Transaction metadata required for payment processing

Data is transmitted only during payment processing or webhook-based payment status updates.

Stripe is a third-party service provided by Stripe, Inc.

Stripe Terms of Service
Stripe Privacy Policy

PayPal

This plugin integrates with PayPal to allow users to complete payments using their PayPal accounts or supported payment methods.

When a payment is initiated, the following data may be sent to PayPal:

  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Transaction and order details
  • User-provided billing information

PayPal is a third-party service provided by PayPal Holdings, Inc.

PayPal User Agreement
PayPal Privacy Policy

PayU

This plugin supports PayU as a payment gateway for processing online payments.

When PayU is used, the plugin may send:

  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Order and transaction details
  • Billing information entered by the user

PayU is a third-party payment service provider.

PayU Terms of Service
PayU Privacy Policy

Razorpay

This plugin integrates with Razorpay to process payments securely.

When Razorpay is enabled and used, the following data may be transmitted:

  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Order identifiers
  • Billing and contact details provided by the user

Razorpay is a third-party service provided by Razorpay Software Private Limited.

Razorpay Terms of Service
Razorpay Privacy Policy

Google reCAPTCHA

Acadlix uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect forms and authentication endpoints from spam and abuse.

When reCAPTCHA is enabled, the following data may be sent to Google:

  • User interaction data (mouse movements, keystrokes, timing)
  • IP address
  • Browser and device information

reCAPTCHA response token generated by the client

This data is sent only for security and spam-prevention purposes and only when reCAPTCHA protection is active.

Google reCAPTCHA is a third-party service provided by Google LLC.

Google Terms of Service
Google Privacy Policy

Support

For support or feature requests, please visit:

  • Plugin Support Forum
  • Acadlix Website

Credits

Developed by the Acadlix Team, creators of the modern and developer-friendly Acadlix LMS.

Build & Source Code

This plugin uses modern JavaScript (React, Webpack) and ships compiled assets
in the /build directory for performance reasons.

The original, human-readable source code is publicly available on GitHub:

Acadlix Free – GitHub Repository

Source files are located in:
– /src/

Compiled production files are generated into:
– /build/

Build Instructions

To reproduce the build files:

  1. Clone the repository
  2. Run npm install
  3. Run npm run build:free

This will generate the contents of the /build directory included in this plugin.

Documentation

For full usage instructions, setup guides, and advanced tips, visit the official documentation:

Acadlix Documentation
sections.installation:
Installing Acadlix takes only a few minutes.

Install from WordPress

  1. Go to Plugins → Add New in your WordPress dashboard.
  2. Search for Acadlix LMS.
  3. Click Install Now.
  4. Activate the plugin.
  5. Open Acadlix from the WordPress admin menu.
  6. Create your first course, quiz, or online exam.

Install Manually

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Upload it through Plugins → Add New → Upload Plugin.
  3. Activate the plugin.
  4. Start building your learning platform from the Acadlix menu.

Optional Setup

To unlock AI-assisted content generation:

• Create an OpenAI API key.

• Add your API key in Acadlix Settings.

• Start generating quiz questions and descriptions.

You can begin creating courses and quizzes immediately without configuring payment gateways or AI features.

Acadlix is built by a team with over 13 years of experience in EdTech and WordPress, focused on solving real challenges faced by educators, institutes, and course creators.1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/, or install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen.
2. Activate the plugin through the “Plugins” menu in WordPress.
3. Go to Acadlix from the admin menu to start creating courses and quizzes.
sections.faq:
Who is Acadlix designed for?

Acadlix is suitable for educators, coaching institutes, schools, colleges, corporate trainers, certification providers, and anyone who wants to build an online learning platform with courses, quizzes, and examinations.

Can I create unlimited courses?

Yes. The free version allows you to create unlimited courses, lessons, quizzes, and students.

Does Acadlix support AI-generated questions?

Yes. Connect your own OpenAI API key to generate quiz questions, validate existing questions, and create course or lesson descriptions. AI usage is billed directly by OpenAI based on your API consumption.

Can I conduct timed online examinations?

Yes. You can create timed quizzes and examinations with automatic grading, negative marking, question randomization, passing scores, and detailed result reports.

Does Acadlix support competitive examinations?

Yes. Acadlix can be used to build mock tests, entrance examinations, certification assessments, and competitive exam platforms. Additional examination features are available in Acadlix Pro.

Can I sell courses without WooCommerce?

Yes. Acadlix includes a built-in payment system for selling courses and test series without requiring WooCommerce.

Which payment gateways are supported?

Acadlix currently supports:

• Stripe

• PayPal

• Razorpay

• PayU

Offline payments are also supported.

Can I issue certificates?

Yes. Certificates are available after learners complete course requirements. Additional certificate customization options are available in the Pro version.

Does Acadlix support live classes?

Yes. Live classes can be scheduled using supported meeting platforms. Additional integrations are available in Acadlix Pro.

Is Acadlix mobile friendly?

Yes. Both the student interface and administrator screens are designed to work across desktop, tablet, and mobile devices.

Does Acadlix work with Elementor?

Yes. Acadlix includes Elementor widgets that help you build custom course pages without coding.

Can I migrate from WP Pro Quiz?

Yes. Acadlix includes a migration tool to help move quizzes from WP Pro Quiz. Advanced migration features are available in Acadlix Pro.

Will Acadlix work with my WordPress theme?

Acadlix follows WordPress development standards and is designed to work with most modern themes. If you encounter compatibility issues, our support team can help.

Do I need coding knowledge?

No. Courses, quizzes, exams, payments, and student management can all be managed from the WordPress dashboard without writing code.

Where can I find documentation?

Complete documentation, tutorials, and setup guides are available on the Acadlix website.

Where can I request new features?

Feature requests and feedback are always welcome. They help us improve Acadlix for educators and organizations around the world.

External Services

Acadlix integrates with third-party services only when certain features are enabled by the site administrator or end users.

Stripe

This plugin integrates with the Stripe payment gateway to securely process online payments.

Stripe is used to handle course purchases, subscriptions, and payment confirmations.

When a user initiates a payment, the following data may be sent to Stripe:

  • Payment amount
  • Currency
  • Billing details provided by the user
  • Transaction metadata required for payment processing

Data is transmitted only during payment processing or webhook-based payment status updates.

Stripe is a third-party service provided by Stripe, Inc.

Stripe Privacy Policy

PayPal

This plugin integrates with PayPal to allow users to complete payments using their PayPal accounts or supported payment methods.

When a payment is initiated, the following data may be sent to PayPal:

  • User-provided billing information

Google reCAPTCHA

Acadlix uses Google reCAPTCHA v3 to protect forms and authentication endpoints from spam and abuse.

When reCAPTCHA is enabled, the following data may be sent to Google:

  • User interaction data (mouse movements, keystrokes, timing)
  • IP address
  • Browser and device information

reCAPTCHA response token generated by the client

This data is sent only for security and spam-prevention purposes and only when reCAPTCHA protection is active.

Google reCAPTCHA is a third-party service provided by Google LLC.

Build Instructions

To reproduce the build files:

  1. Clone the repository
  2. Run npm install
  3. Run npm run build:free

This will generate the contents of the /build directory included in this plugin.
